# Reborn Nails & Retreat
> Premium nail salon, spa pedicure, Vietnamese head spa & waxing in Da Nang, Vietnam. ★4.9 from 150+ Google reviews. 5-minute walk from My Khe Beach.

Address: 56 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Da Nang 550000, Vietnam
Hours: daily 09:00–20:00 · Walk-ins welcome · Phone: +84 788 668 588
Languages: English · 한국어 · 日本語 · Русский · Français · Español · 中文
Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=6841420951448602085
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reborn_nailsnretreat/

## Prices (thousand VND, 100K ≈ $4)
- Gel polish 200K · BIAB 300K · GelX 280K · Manicure 70K
- Nail art: cat-eye/chrome full set 180K, ombré/French 220K, per-nail art 10K–100K
- Spa pedicure rituals 250K–590K (best seller: Deep Care 450K, 65 min)
- Head spa / Vietnamese hair wash 120K–850K (signature 500K, 80 min)
- Waxing 90K–480K
